Here is the commute comparison for Stratford and Bow to Liverpool Street, based on the TfL Journey Planner data gathered for you.

**Commute time and cost per day, week and month (3 office days per week)**

| | Stratford | Bow | Saving (Bow vs Stratford) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Journey time (one way) | 20 min | 28 min | Stratford is 8 min faster each way |
| Time per office day (return) | 40 min | 56 min | Stratford saves 16 min per office day |
| Time per week (3 office days) | 120 min (2.0 hours) | 168 min (2.8 hours) | Stratford saves 48 min per week |
| Time per month (13 commuting days) | 520 min (~8.7 hours) | 728 min (~12.1 hours) | Stratford saves 208 min (~3.5 hours) per month |
| Transport cost per day (PAYG daily cap) | £10.50 | £8.90 | Bow is £1.60 cheaper per office day |
| Transport cost per week | £31.50 | £26.70 | Bow is £4.80 cheaper per week |
| Transport cost per month (13 days) | £136.50 | £115.70 | Bow is £20.80 cheaper per month |

**How to read this**

- Stratford wins clearly on time: 20 minutes versus 28 minutes each way, which works out at roughly 3.5 hours less commuting per month across your 13 office days.
- Bow wins on cost: it sits in Zone 2 rather than Zone 3, so the daily cap is £8.90 instead of £10.50. Over a month that is £20.80 less, or £115.70 versus £136.50.
- The monthly figures use 13 commuting days (3 office days × 52 weeks ÷ 12 months). Holidays and extra travel are not modelled.

**Practical notes**

- Both monthly costs are based on PAYG daily caps, which the data flags as an upper bound — actual single fares may cost less. For both areas the PAYG daily-cap approach (£136.50 Stratford, £115.70 Bow) is cheaper than the equivalent monthly Travelcard (£201.60 Zone 1-3, £171.70 Zone 1-2) on a 3-day hybrid pattern.
- Zones here are postcode-district estimates, not verified station coverage, so check the exact walk to your nearest station before committing.
- An 18+ Student Oyster discount applies to Travelcards, not standard PAYG — worth checking if your pattern ever increases.

**Bottom line:** if time matters most, Stratford is the better base (about 3.5 hours a month saved); if budget matters most, Bow is cheaper by £20.80 a month. The trade-off is roughly 16 minutes of extra daily travel for £1.60 a day saved.
